style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dark-and-light alternating premium tech audio ecommerce visual system across the entire set; fixed palette of deep charcoal background #2E3338, pure white #FFFFFF, light ice-grey section background #E9EFF1, and a single mint-cyan accent #5FE0C8 for badges, glow rings, callout pins and stat highlights; cool tone; modern geometric sans-serif typography with a thin light-grey English eyebrow line above every headline; alternating full-bleed deep charcoal and clean white or light ice-grey sections with soft vignettes and subtle geometric shapes such as soft spheres, a matte round podium and glowing ring motifs; soft studio key light with gentle rim light on dark screens and bright even high-key light on light screens, soft contact shadows so the product never floats; thin-line white icons inside circular neumorphic badges and small circular pin callouts in the accent color; product centered with stable scale and a consistent front 3/4 hero angle for packshots; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no exaggerated glow effects.
style.presentationRules: product centered with stable scale; consistent front 3/4 hero angle for packshots; product always grounded with a soft contact shadow, never floating; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
style.surfaceSystem: matte dark podium disc, matte light-grey desk corner, seamless studio backdrop
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; thin light-grey English eyebrow line above every headline; white headlines on dark screens, charcoal #2D2D2D headlines on light screens
